budget_enforcement.provider_schema: Recorded /api_usage shape (grounded in -11 bracket receipts 2026-10-23): {timestamp 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' UTC, current_usage int, plan_limit int, daily_usage int, plan_daily_limit int, plan_category str}. Strict parse (parse_usage_body); the day counter is daily_usage against plan_daily_limit.
rules: Start-of-day baseline: the day's first /api_usage snapshot (09:25 ET; Nov 2 closing snapshot 08:05) is parsed and recorded as the day baseline before any time_series call that day (the 08:00 revision batch may precede it; it is reconciled at the 09:25 reading).

Fail-closed STOP on: non-200 usage response; malformed/unparseable usage body; plan_daily_limit != 800; provider timestamp skew > 600s; provider counter unmoving across >=3 intervening non-usage calls (stale); provider undercount vs desk beyond tolerance 2 (ambiguous).
Provider headroom before each call: effective usage = last reading + desk calls since; STOP before the call if plan_daily_limit - effective < pending worst-case TD actions for the execution day.
External consumption: provider delta exceeding desk delta by > 2 is recorded as an external-usage event (state + journal); the headroom rule then decides stop/continue.
Local caps (unchanged values, widened scope): 800 pilot total + 149 per EXECUTION day, covering usage + revision traffic, keyed by the ET date the call executes.
Zero paid credits: Basic free tier only; no tier change, no spend.
